title: Verify background music plays successfully on user interaction
steps:
1. Open the animated portfolio website.
2. Locate the background music control (play button/toggle).
3. Click the play button to start the background music.
expected: The background music starts playing smoothly without audio distortion or lagging.

title: Verify PDF download for an invoice with a very large number of line items
steps:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel.
2. Create an invoice with an extremely high number of line items (e.g., 100+ items).
3. Navigate to the Invoices section.
4. Download the PDF for this invoice.
expected: The PDF should generate and download successfully, displaying all line items without truncation, formatting issues, or performance degradation (e.g., timeout). The pagination within the PDF should be correct if applicable.

title: Verify download when client's local storage is full
steps:
1. (Pre-condition) Simulate a full local storage scenario on the client's machine (e.g., by filling up the hard drive).
2. Log in to the Admin Panel.
3. Navigate to the Invoices section.
4. Attempt to download an invoice PDF.
expected: The browser should typically display an error indicating that there isn't enough disk space to save the file. The application should not crash or exhibit unexpected behavior.

title: Verify PDF download for an invoice with zero or very small monetary values
steps:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel.
2. Create an invoice where all line item amounts are 0, or very small decimal values (e.g., 0.01).
3. Navigate to the Invoices section.
4. Download the PDF for this invoice.
expected: The PDF should generate and download successfully, accurately displaying the zero or small monetary values and the correct total amount.

title: Verify download of multiple large invoices (bulk download size consideration)
steps:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel.
2. Create several invoices, each with a large number of line items or extensive descriptions, making them individually large.
3. Select all these large invoices for a bulk download.
4. Initiate the bulk PDF download.
expected: The system should successfully generate and download the collective PDF (or ZIP file) without timeouts or memory errors. The total size of the downloaded file(s) should be manageable by the server and client.

title: Verify successful PDF download for a single invoice
steps:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel.
2. Navigate to the Invoices section.
3. Select a specific invoice from the list.
4. Click on the 'Download PDF' or equivalent button for that invoice.
expected: The PDF file of the selected invoice should be successfully downloaded to the user's default download directory and should be viewable with correct content.

title: Verify PDF download for an invoice with special characters in client/item names
steps:
1. Log in to the Admin Panel.
2. Create or edit an invoice with special characters (e.g., !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, *, (), _, +, =, `, ~, ?, <, >, /, \, [, ], {, }, |, ;, :, ', ", comma, periods, accented letters) in the client name, item names, or descriptions.
3. Navigate to the Invoices section.
4. Download the PDF for this invoice.
expected: The downloaded PDF should correctly display all special characters without corruption or encoding issues.

Verify Absence of Google Authentication UI (Initial State)
steps:
1. Open the portfolio website in a web browser.
2. Navigate through all available pages and sections (Home, About, Projects, Contact, etc.).
3. Look for any 'Sign in with Google', 'Login with Google', or similar authentication buttons/links.
expected: No Google authentication user interface elements should be present on any part of the website, indicating the feature is not yet implemented.

title: Session Persistence After Google Login
steps:
1. Log in successfully using a valid Google account.
2. Close the browser tab or window, or completely close the browser application.
3. Reopen the application's URL in a new browser instance.
expected: Depending on the implementation's session management strategy (e.g., using local storage, cookies, or refresh tokens), the user should either remain logged in or be automatically re-authenticated without needing to re-enter credentials.

title: Handling Network Interruption During Login
steps:
1. (Once implemented) Navigate to the login/authentication page.
2. Initiate the 'Sign in with Google' process.
3. Disconnect from the internet (e.g., turn off Wi-Fi or unplug Ethernet cable) before the authentication process completes.
4. Reconnect to the internet and observe the application state.
expected: The application should gracefully handle the network interruption, displaying an informative error message (e.g., 'Network error', 'Failed to connect to Google'). The user should not be logged in, and the application should allow retrying the login after network restoration.

title: Successful Google Logout
steps:
1. Log in successfully using a valid Google account.
2. Locate and click on the 'Logout' or 'Sign Out' button/link (e.g., in a user profile menu).
3. Confirm any logout prompts if they appear.
expected: The user should be successfully logged out of the application. The application should return to the login page or a public home page, and any authenticated user data should no longer be accessible or displayed.

title: User Cancels Google Authentication Process
steps:
1. (Once implemented) Navigate to the login/authentication page.
2. Click on the 'Sign in with Google' button.
3. When the Google authentication consent screen appears (either pop-up or redirect), choose to 'Cancel' the process or close the window.
expected: The user should not be logged in and should remain on the login page or be redirected back to it without error. No partial account creation or erroneous state should occur.

title: Successful Google Login with Valid Credentials
steps:
1. (Once implemented) Navigate to the designated login/authentication page.
2. Click on the 'Sign in with Google' button.
3. In the Google authentication pop-up/redirect, select a valid Google account that has granted necessary permissions.
4. Complete the Google authentication flow.
expected: The user should be successfully authenticated and redirected to a post-login page (e.g., an admin dashboard, profile page, or personalized content area). User's Google profile information (e.g., name, avatar) should be correctly displayed.

title: Viewer role access denial on mutation endpoints
steps:
1. Authenticate with Viewer JWT
2. Send POST /api/projects
expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden error response

title: Webhook delivery failure exponential backoff schedule
steps:
1. Configure webhook pointing to offline server
2. Trigger event
expected: System retries at 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h schedules

title: Virtual scrolling memory retention with 50,000 table rows
steps:
1. Load 50k rows in viewport
2. Rapidly scroll top to bottom
expected: DOM node count remains under 100 with zero frame stutter

title: WebSocket connection heartbeat & automatic reconnection
steps:
1. Initiate GraphQL subscription
2. Terminate network connection
3. Restore network
expected: Client automatically reconnects and re-subscribes within 3000ms

title: Idempotency key enforcement on multiple rapid charge POSTs
steps:
1. Submit charge with Idempotency-Key header
2. Re-submit identical payload with same header
expected: Second request returns cached response without duplicate billing

title: Verify PKCE authorization code exchange handshake
steps:
1. Request authorization endpoint
2. Intercept redirect URI
3. POST code to /token with code_verifier
expected: HTTP 200 with id_token and access_token
